panels.title: Redis L1.5 Failures
panels.description: Redis cache writes, invalidation publishes and evictions that failed (each also a WARN line). Non-zero: replicas may serve stale cached vectors until the entry expires.

panels.title: Config Warnings
panels.description: Entries in /health config_warnings: a configuration the server started with but warned about (upgrade readings, unknown names, values it could not honour). Alert on > 0.

panels.title: Degraded Components
panels.description: Components /health lists under degraded (dakera_component_degraded == 1).

panels.title: WAL Write Failures (1h)
panels.description: Write-ahead-log appends that failed; each one refused a write.

panels.title: Memory Read Failures (1h)
panels.description: Memories a read path skipped because their content did not open (wrong or missing key, tampered value).

panels.title: Degraded Components
panels.description: 1 while a component is degraded (redis_cache, disk_cache, backups, ml_classifier, cluster_gossip, knowledge_graph, cluster_outbox, cluster_auth, wal_replay, cluster_sync_held, …).

panels.title: Backups by Outcome
panels.description: Backups finished per hour, completed / failed.

panels.title: Model Loads by Outcome
panels.description: Lazy loads of the embedding, reranker, NER, whisper and vision models (idle models are unloaded and loaded again on their next use).

panels.title: Model Load Duration p95
panels.description: A first download takes minutes; a reload from the local cache seconds.

panels.title: Process Memory
panels.description: Resident memory and the working memory the I3 budget has reserved for media jobs and GLiNER passes.

panels.title: Memory Shedding & Reclaim
panels.description: Requests refused for memory (503 + Retry-After) and memory-pressure reclaim cycles (idle models unloaded, caches dropped).

panels.title: Overload Refusals by Status
panels.description: Requests answered 408 (request timeout), 413 (body limit), 429 (rate limit) or 503 (admission, inference queue, memory budget, maintenance).

panels.title: Representation / FDE Cache Bytes
panels.description: Byte-bounded derived caches (budgets derived from the memory limit).

panels.title: Late Interaction
panels.description: Late-interaction (MaxSim) searches and their first stages per 5 min: FDE vs dense first stage, index builds, dense fallbacks.

panels.title: Late Interaction Cold Fallbacks
panels.description: FDE first stages built from a partial sidecar scan because the cold tier was unreachable.

panels.title: Vectors per Tier
panels.description: DAKERA_TIERED_STORAGE only.

panels.title: Cold Tier Backlog
panels.description: Writes acknowledged by the hot tier whose cold (S3) copy has not landed yet.

panels.title: Cold Read Circuit
panels.description: 0 closed, 1 half-open (one probe), 2 open (cold reads refused after repeated failures).

panels.title: Sync Outbox & Held Entries
panels.description: Changes waiting for a peer (retry outbox), and changes held for peers still on v0.11.

panels.title: Compaction & Stalls
panels.description: DAKERA_HOT_TIER=rocksdb (the tiered default).
